questions.q: In a pictograph, data is shown using ____.
questions.explanation: A pictograph uses symbols to represent a number of items.

questions.q: How many items does a tally group of five (four lines struck through by a fifth) show?
questions.explanation: The fifth line crosses the four to make a group of 5.

questions.q: What is the mean (average) of 4, 6 and 8?
What is the range of the data 3, 9, 5, 12, 2?
A bar graph is mostly used to ____.
questions.explanation: The height or length of each bar shows the value of a category.

questions.q: The number of times a value occurs in the data is called its ____.
questions.explanation: Frequency means how often a value appears.
